title: 连接微伴员工账号
description: 本预览包使用已签发的员工 Agent Secret。凭证由 WorkBuddy 保存在本机，并在调用时通过 HTTPS 发送给微伴服务；不要填写企业 OpenAPI secret。企业两字段首次授权模式尚需单独适配。
description_en: This preview uses an issued employee Agent Secret. WorkBuddy stores it locally and sends it to Weiban over HTTPS. Do not enter a corporate OpenAPI secret.
docLabel: 查看微伴凭证与安装说明
